title: First Bus Rochdale wins national Gold for Routes to Work scheme
excerpt: First Bus Rochdale’s employability programme has won Gold at the UK Bus Awards after helping local young people build skills and move into work.
body:
First Bus Rochdale’s Routes to Work programme has won Gold in the Bus and the Community category at the 2026 UK Bus Awards, adding to the operator’s Community Engagement Award at the Rochdale Business Awards.

The national winners were announced in London on Tuesday 24 November. The UK Bus Awards named Routes to Work as the Gold winner ahead of schemes from First Bus West Yorkshire and Arriva Merseyside.

Routes to Work was created to help young people who are not in education, employment or training gain workplace experience, build confidence and prepare for jobs. Participants received practical experience at First Bus’s Rochdale depot alongside support with CVs, applications and interviews.

First Bus said the first programme involved four young people and that two had secured full-time work by October. One joined the engineering stores team at the Rochdale depot, while another found work with Rochdale firm Royton Steelstock.

The local Community Engagement Award recognised a wider year of work with schools, colleges, charities and community groups. First Bus was also shortlisted for Business of the Year at the Rochdale ceremony.

Zoe Hands, managing director of First Bus Franchising, said: “These awards belong to our colleagues and partners, whose passion and commitment help create opportunities for people across Rochdale every day.”

Kevin Mullin, social value manager at First Bus Rochdale, said the recognition reflected the combined work of staff, partners and volunteers supporting local people and strengthening community links.

For Rochdale residents, the award highlights a practical local route into employment for young people who may lack experience or established workplace contacts.

Have you taken part in Routes to Work or another local employment programme? Tell us what helped you move towards work in the comments.

Sources: First Bus Corporate press office, 27 November 2026; UK Bus Awards 2026 results; Rochdale Development Agency.
